title: Universal Life Insurance Contract Provisions: Full Surrender
content:
**Right of surrender.** The owner of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy may surrender the policy for its cash surrender value.

**Signatures.** A full surrender is processed only on a surrender request signed by the owner, and also by every irrevocable beneficiary and any collateral assignee of record. The signatures are read from the surrender request on the policy's service record.

**Effective date.** The surrender is effective on the date the signed request is received.

**Provisions no longer in force.** The following provisions of this contract are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis for the full-surrender charge, the cash surrender value and its taxation:

- that the surrender charge is the initial face amount divided by 1000 times the schedule rate for the policy year in which the surrender is effective, rounded to the cent, and zero after the surrender charge years;
- that the cash surrender value is the account value less the surrender charge, less the loan balance and loan interest accrued to the effective date;
- that the taxable amount is the account value less the surrender charge less the cost basis, never below zero, with federal tax withheld at the default federal withholding rate of it unless the owner elected none.

The tier's surrender charge schedule, surrender charge years and default federal withholding rate remain the tier's figures.

## Signature requirement by situation (hypothetical)

| Designation and assignment on record | Signatures required on the surrender request |
|---|---|
| Revocable beneficiaries only, no assignment | The owner |
| One irrevocable beneficiary, no assignment | The owner and that irrevocable beneficiary |
| Revocable beneficiaries, a collateral assignee of record | The owner and the collateral assignee |
| Two irrevocable beneficiaries and a collateral assignee | The owner, both irrevocable beneficiaries and the assignee |

*Effective date example (hypothetical).* A surrender request signed on 2 June and received on 6 June is effective on 6 June.

superseded_clauses: The surrender charge is the initial face amount divided by 1,000 times the surrender_charge_ladder rate for the policy year in which the surrender is effective, rounded to the cent; it is zero after surrender_charge_years.
The cash surrender value is the account value less the surrender charge, less the loan balance and loan interest accrued to the effective date.

The taxable amount is the account value less the surrender charge less the cost basis, never below zero, and federal tax is withheld at federal_withholding_default_pct of it unless the owner elected none.
